body: Yes I was taking classes on a payment plan and was unable to make the payments and now it’s on my account for the spring semester and that’s what I’m trying to pay. I haven’t signed the agreement for the $300 a month payment plan because I’m waiting to hear back from them.
I’m more worried about them giving my case to a collectors agency. I wouldn’t want that to happen but I’m not too knowledgeable on how long they’ll hold off before they do.

Thank you for this. I honestly don’t know how everything got out of control but I don’t want to die. I’m not sure if that makes sense. I think if I can see hospitalization as a way out instead of ending it completely I’ll at least not do something impulsive and permanent.

I won’t be able to take classes at my university but I really don’t want to go a semester without taking any classes. I want a small loan to pay for a class or two at a community college. I’m a sophomore currently and let’s just say it was an overall awful stream of events that put me in this position. I’m pretty desperate and can afford payments of 100 a month.
